{"answer":"资料未把“远程工作环境变化”明确列为触发培训内容更新的情形，因此不能据此断言培训内容必须随远程工作环境变化而调整。

资料中的相关要求是：
- 培训与意识内容应按待组织确定的频率更新，并在待组织确定的事件发生后更新（at-2_smt.c，参数 at-02_odp.06 为更新频率、at-02_odp.07 为触发更新的事件，均未赋值）。
- 资料列举的可能促使更新的事件包括评估或审计发现、安全事件或违规、适用法律/行政命令/指令/法规/政策/标准/指南的变化，但明确“包括但不限于”，并非穷尽清单。
- 资料在说明培训内容确定依据时提到工作环境（例如远程办公/telework），但这是确定培训内容的考虑因素，并未表述为“工作环境变化即触发内容更新”的强制要求。

记忆点/易混淆点：不要把“确定培训内容时考虑工作环境”等同于“工作环境变化属于必须更新内容的事件”；后者在资料中没有明确规定。","source_ids":[1]}
issues.source_excerpt: Awareness techniques include displaying posters, offering supplies inscribed with security and privacy reminders, displaying logon screen messages, generating email advisories or notices from organizational officials, and conducting awareness events. Literacy training after the initial training described in [AT-2a.1](#at-2_smt.a.1) is conducted at a minimum frequency consistent with applicable laws, directives, regulations, and policies. Subsequent literacy training may be satisfied by one or more short ad hoc sessions and include topical information on recent attack schemes, changes to organizational security and privacy policies, revised security and privacy expectations, or a subset of topics from the initial training. Updating literacy training and awareness content on a regular basis helps to ensure that the content remains relevant. Events that may precipitate an update to literacy training and awareness content include, but are not limited to, assessment or audit findings, security incidents or breaches, or changes in applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines.
